name: IoT Telemetry Pipeline
description: Four levels deep: architect, platform lead, ingestion lead, and two specialists.

cto.responsibilities: Own the device-to-dashboard telemetry architecture, set latency and retention targets, and delegate the platform and analytics tracks.

platform.responsibilities: Device registry, MQTT broker, provisioning and the ingestion track as a whole.

ingest.responsibilities: Stream ingestion, backpressure, schema evolution and the time-series store.

stream.responsibilities: Kafka topics, partitioning, consumer groups and exactly-once semantics.

storage.responsibilities: Time-series schema, downsampling, compaction and retention tiers.

analytics.responsibilities: Alerting rules, aggregation queries and the operator dashboard.
